column2: [intro]
I look at the girls with envy,
Their sweet looks and their bodies mesmerize me infinitely.
But society dictates rules to me,
I must hide my emotions, keep the blinding silence.
In my dreams, I want to be different,
Love the one who would make me shine.
In a world where everything would be allowed,
But I am a man, it is forbidden.
In solitude, I feel this frustration,
Not being able to freely express my affection.
Words remain stuck in my throat,
I am lost, away from the one my heart creates.
In my dreams, I want to be different,
Love the one who would make me shine.
In a world where everything would be allowed,
But I am a man, it is forbidden.
[ solo ]
Deep inside, a feeling hides,
The obvious desire to be in that "trash" environment.
Defy the norms, live without regrets,
But my gender limits me, it's a secret.
[outro]
